correctness.rationale: Constructed all 140 disconnected triples and 3906 cut-complex simplices; computed exact rational Alexander-dual boundary ranks 11,49,30, giving dimensions H7=1,H8=6. Enumerated all 120 icosahedral graph automorphisms, signed fixed-face Lefschetz numbers and independently a homology generator over F1009. A5 perfectness forces H7 rotations trivial; the H8 rotational character (6,-2,0,1,1) equals the rational 6-dimensional irreducible. Central inversion and its Lefschetz value -5 force antipodal sign on both homology groups, giving the complete character. Finite quotient invariants follow by characteristic-zero transfer; no infinite extension is asserted.

value.rationale: Determines the missing complete full icosahedral rational action on both nonzero degrees of a distinguished nonshellable Platonic cut complex, including the Galois-paired six-dimensional irreducible. Distinguishes rotational, antipodal and full symmetry quotient rational homology in a way not implied by published Betti numbers. The object, invariant and exact classification are natural to current cut-complex literature; the result is not a routine arithmetic restatement.
